markdown_sections.title: Doom Term v1.1.5
markdown_sections.markdown: The status plate holds confirmed WAITING, CONTEXT, and five-hour USAGE readings through brief pauses, incomplete agent records, and transient failures. The working mark repaints at 20 frames per second without rebuilding the workspace. Claude and Codex record reading is more resilient, including separate Codex sessions in one directory; the Python 3.6-compatible remote helpers preserve reports while an agent is idle. See docs/doom-term/remote-agent-status.md for setup and evidence.html for before/after measurements and verification limits.

markdown_sections.title: Manual installation
markdown_sections.markdown: Doom Term does not check for or install updates automatically. Install a newer package manually after saving your work and closing the application. Release notes are bundled with each build.
